sections.title: Professional Summary
bullets: Engineer with 4+ years of project execution and marine/offshore operations experience, combining planning, progress control, forecasting, risk management, KPI analysis and multidisciplinary stakeholder coordination.

Hands-on experience with daily/weekly/monthly reporting, 15-day look-ahead planning, schedule and production follow-up, deviation analysis, corrective actions, measurements and cost control; MBA in Project Management, Advanced Excel, Power BI and MS Project.

sections.title: Core Expertise
sections.content: Project Planning · Scheduling · Progress Monitoring · Look-Ahead Planning · Forecasting · Baseline & Deviation Follow-Up · Corrective Actions · KPI & Performance Reporting · Risk Management · Cost & Measurement Control · MS Project · Power BI · Advanced Excel · Stakeholder Management · Offshore Operations · QHSE · Multidisciplinary Coordination

lead.title: Superintendent 1 — Marine Projects & Operations | Van Oord (Jul 2021–Nov 2024)
lead.body: Monitored and controlled project execution across Brazilian ports, coordinating vessels, clients, terminals, suppliers and internal teams. Managed operational planning, 15-day look-aheads, progress follow-up, KPIs, forecasts, deviations, recovery actions, measurements, costs and project reporting.

bullets: Developed and maintained operational plans and look-ahead schedules, aligning vessel availability, resources, logistics and project priorities.
Monitored progress against planned execution, identified deviations and coordinated corrective/recovery actions with project, vessel and support teams.
Prepared daily, weekly and monthly reports, forecasts and KPI analyses covering production, availability, downtime, fuel and operational performance.
Supported measurements, cost follow-up, claims/change interfaces, suppliers and project close-out activities.
Facilitated alignment with clients, captains, engineers, terminals, agents and multidisciplinary teams in international project environments.
Planned and coordinated personnel, materials, suppliers and operational readiness for FPSO/OSV maintenance and cleaning campaigns.
Produced DPR/RDO reports, monitored deliverables and deviations, and maintained operational information in Petrobras Drake / SAP RT.
Mapped processes and created procedures and document-control practices during the company’s ISO 9001 preparation.
Continued development in Power BI, structured data, SQL/Python and automation while managing roadmap, dependencies, risks and iterative delivery for apollo::rio.
Primavera P6 knowledge under development.
Delivered technical training and translated SOPs for multinational offshore teams, strengthening technical communication and cross-functional coordination.
